entry.summary: Identity read-decision cache lookup in packages/identity/policy.mjs canRead() (lines 6-12): the function first calls store.readDecisions.get(projectId) and returns the cached decision when defined. On a miss, it computes the authorization result as store.projects.get(projectId)?.members.has(userId) === true and stores it via store.readDecisions.set(projectId, result). The cache key is projectId alone; the requesting userId is not part of the key, so authorization decisions for the same project are shared across all users of the store. By contrast, requireFreshMembership() (lines 14-16) performs no cache lookup and always re-checks membership directly against store.projects.
